# Nexyra Studio

> Nexyra Studio is a web and software development agency founded in Faisalabad,
> Pakistan in 2022. We build the systems service businesses run on: websites
> that generate enquiries, online booking and CRM platforms, custom software,
> and the mobile apps that sit alongside them. We work in Next.js, React and
> TypeScript on the front end, with Nest.js, Node, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL,
> MySQL and Supabase behind it. Clients are in Pakistan, the UK, the US, the
> UAE and Australia. Every project starts with a free 30-minute call and a
> written scope with a fixed price before any work begins.

Contact: support@nexyrastudio.com · +92 315 7558885 (WhatsApp) · Faisalabad, Pakistan

## Services

- [Web Development](https://nexyrastudio.com/web-development): Custom website development for businesses in Pakistan and worldwide. Fast, mobile-first sites with booking, forms and CRM built in.
- [App Development](https://nexyrastudio.com/app-development): Android and iOS apps from one codebase — booking apps, delivery apps, customer portals and internal staff tools, including Play Store and App Store publishing.
- [SEO & Digital Marketing](https://nexyrastudio.com/seo-digital-marketing): Local SEO, Google Business Profile setup, technical audits, and Google and Meta ads. Monthly reporting on enquiries and calls, not just traffic. No lock-in contracts.
- [Booking & CRM Systems](https://nexyrastudio.com/booking-crm-systems): Online appointment booking, customer CRM, automated SMS and email reminders, and the automation that removes repetitive admin work.

## Industry-specific booking systems

- [Clinic Booking System](https://nexyrastudio.com/booking-system-for-clinics): Patient booking, multi-provider scheduling, SMS and email reminders and patient records for US clinics and dental practices. HIPAA-aware builds. Custom built, not a subscription.
- [Salon Booking Software](https://nexyrastudio.com/salon-booking-software): Stylist-wise online booking with real service durations, deposits to cut no-shows, SMS reminders and client history. Works for single salons and multiple locations.

## Local

- [Web Development in Faisalabad](https://nexyrastudio.com/web-development-faisalabad): Website and software development in Faisalabad — meet in person, work in Urdu or English, and build a site with booking and enquiries.
